title: Pixel Drawing Sandbox
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Demonstrate the effect of `pixel()`, `hline()`, and `vline()` calls by drawing directly on a simulated frame buffer, and execute the correct tool choice for horizontal, vertical, and single-dot marks.

learningObjectives: Demonstrate the effect of `pixel()`, `hline()`, and `vline()` calls by drawing directly on a simulated frame buffer, and execute the correct tool choice for horizontal, vertical, and single-dot marks.
